title: Tiếng gọi xa
about: Round 25, ke-chuyen ("bạn hãy tự sáng tác những bản khác hay hơn, phối theo kiểu bạn đề xuất"): G-sharp minor at 68 bpm. Its motif is a call: one note struck twice, then a leap up a sixth (D#-D#-B), answered from afar by the cellos each time the tune holds; sung again a step lower over C#m; the middle section in B major climbs to E6, D#sus4 resolving to D#7. The arc here: the piano and the cellos' far answers first; the violas join with a thin line; the climax with the strings and the piano's rolled chords; the piano alone to the last call, and the cellos answer it once more. An original tune.
